The keep guards in Everfrost are often broken into three solo camps:

The two giants in the "Front" {{Loc|Everfrost Peaks|(1752, -6465), (1994, -6465)}} spawn between levels 39 and 42.

The one in the "Back" {{Loc|Everfrost Peaks|(1834, -6865)}} spawns between levels 38 and 41.

Only ice giants within [[Permafrost]] drop the [[Block of Permafrost]].
